target.unverifiedTiaMajorVersionsNote: The V21 build target is maintained in the repo as a first-class target, but it could NOT be built or verified on this machine: TIA V21 is not installed here, so the Siemens Openness 21.x package (which IS present in the NuGet cache, 21.0.1765349347) cannot resolve its reference assemblies. That package self-resolves Siemens.Engineering.*.dll from <TiaPortalLocation>\PublicAPI\V21\net48 or the HKLM\SOFTWARE\Siemens\Automation\Openness\21.0 registry key; with no Portal V21 installed neither exists and the build emits CS0246. Build and verify on a host that has TIA V21 before relying on it. V18 requires the V18 build (hides 23 WinCC Unified tools).

runtimeLayout.note: Version-aware self-routing (Siemens/EngineRouter.cs): the bundle ships one exe per TIA major version under runtime/v<NN>/, and the plugin entry (.mcp.json -> runtime/v21/TiaMcpServer.exe) re-execs the sibling exe matching the TIA version actually installed on the host. This requires the sibling directories to exist.
runtimeLayout.verifiedRouting: runtime/v21 exe on this V20 host: detected V20 -> re-exec runtime/v20/TiaMcpServer.exe -> TIA Openness API initialized (verified 2026-09-28).
runtimeLayout.v21ExecutableNote: runtime/v21/TiaMcpServer.exe is the upstream-shipped binary (unmodified, 1700864 bytes, 2026-07-04 build). It predates the VersionControl (VCI) and CompileAndDiagnoseHmi tools, which is why it must reroute to runtime/v20 on a V20 host rather than serve tools itself. A genuine V21 rebuild is only possible on a host with TIA V21 installed.

selfContainedScope.description: The bundle contains runtime, skill, manuals, templates and blueprints required for PLC + WinCC Unified project generation.
bundled: PLC instruction recipes, PlcBuildAndImport JSON templates, LAD recipes and SCL examples
Project generation runbook and validation checklist

Project-specific process logic, site names or business program segments

cli.description: Same exe also runs as a declarative CLI: `tia <verb>`. Any AI can emit a YAML/JSON spec; any engineer runs one command. No MCP client required.

capabilities.v18HiddenToolsNote: 23 WinCC Unified HMI tools are hidden in the V18 build via #if !TIA_V18 (231 - 23 = 208).
fixedThisRelease: EngineRouter.TryRedirect (Siemens/EngineRouter.cs): the redirect re-exec used to be unguarded, so on .NET Framework (where ProcessStartInfo.EnvironmentVariables is a case-INSENSITIVE Hashtable) any host environment carrying case-variant duplicate variables (e.g. HTTP_PROXY and http_proxy, common under Git Bash / MSYS / some CI runners) made the psi.EnvironmentVariables[TIAMCP_NO_REDIRECT] assignment throw ArgumentException and abort with an opaque FATAL. It now removes any same-key entry first and wraps the re-exec in try/catch, degrading to a log + 'staying in this exe' instead of crashing.

Program.cs version-routing warning: when a sibling exe existed but re-execing it failed, the WARN wrongly claimed no sibling was found. It now distinguishes 'no sibling build present' from 'sibling found but re-exec failed' and points at the concrete EngineRouter log line.

manifest/tools-list.json + manifest/package-manifest.json: regenerated to 231 tools (L0 6 / L1 57 / L2 168), bringing the two manifests back into agreement (the VCI and CompileAndDiagnoseHmi tools had been added without resyncing tools-list.json).

runtime/: added the missing runtime/v18 and runtime/v20 sibling directories (64-file runtime sets) so version-aware self-routing can actually delegate on V18/V20 hosts instead of crashing; runtime/v21 remains the upstream-shipped binary, unmodified.
supports: button Down/Up actions and tag dynamization

read-only online live-value monitoring over S7 (port 102) and OPC UA (port 4840): single read, trend sampling (PID step-response capture), watch-table live read, CPU RUN/STOP state, and offline+live tag causal trace
reflection-based API discovery for uncovered Openness shapes
